candidateSources.title: Phase behavior of (CO2 + H2) and (CO2 + N2) at temperatures between (218.15 and 303.15) K at pressures up to 15 MPa
candidateSources.accessibleMetadata: VLE data are reported for CO2+H2 and CO2+N2 over 218.15 K to 303.15 K up to 15 MPa.

implementationAudit.nativeBridgeSupport: A generic diagnostic binary VLE bridge now accepts the EOS-CG CO2+H2 formulation, fixed liquid component-2 composition and optional initial guesses.
implementationAudit.providerSupport: TeqpProvider exposes only density for CO2+H2 mixtures.

productionDecision.reason: No audited open numerical binary CO2+H2 x/y/P/T matrix was encoded. The targeted pass found ThermoML ternary CO2+H2+methanol data and unrelated systems, but no CCS-relevant binary validation artifact suitable for production gating.
